crossRefs.note: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom…
He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater…

people.name: Agag
people.line: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel

people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Hammedatha
people.line: The father of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.

translations.web: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.
translations.bsb: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him to a position above all the princes who were with him.
translations.kjv: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes
translations.asv: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.
